items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: I’d be with Harry’s band and Frank Sinatra Junior would come in with somebody — I got two days, three days at the most I’d get a call. Ring. Can you come in, so-and-so hurt his chops.

ctx.x: In L.A. in the studios, when I was there. That’s the way almost everything was done that way. Very seldom did the entire band get together and play. Like Sinatra always kept the full band when he recorded. He didn’t do it the other way. Vic Damone, he did it with a full band.
Do they put them in a booth or something?
